definitions.same_context: Exact context string equality, including any empty strings.
definitions.same_context_and_unordered_options: Exact context equality and equality of sorted two-option string lists; no labels used.
definitions.same_example_id: Exact example_id equality across each assigned history-target pair.
definitions.same_nonempty_group_id: Exact nonempty group_id equality across each assigned history-target pair.

limitations: Checks only projected selected histories and assigned targets; it does not independently establish raw-source fidelity or exclude broader conceptual similarity.
Counts include the withheld target cell as part of the frozen planned denominator.
scope: Assigned own and donor selected fit Choices versus their assigned targets, solely within the approved capture. No source refs, target labels or outcomes read.
